scores.tell: Map fills the card well but is slightly small and low; stacked folds fine. Generous empty space top and bottom, minor.
Clock is large and cropped near the left edge and bottom, tight margins, but similar to the real ferris wheel and towel cards. Very close.
Truss spans edge to edge and competes with the spotlight for attention; the spotlight is cropped by the lower-left edge. Busy first read.
Full scene fills the card, and the train is tilted off-center and crowded by the background. The locomotive does not stand out from the desert. Looks like a scene, not an object.
Fins are tilted and centered with good scale and a plain radial background. Reads instantly, like the real cards.
Bottle is big, tilted and centered on a burst background. Strong silhouette and the first read is instant. Like the real whistle card.
Cauldron fills the card, but the pavement floor and striped wall make a scene. Lower edge is busy. Much like the barrel lesson.
Rover is smaller, with lots of ground and gray rocks around it. Hero is not dominant and the lunar ground competes. Scene-like composition.
Bush stack is centered with a big hedge, lawn and path behind it. The green hero blends into the green background and the scene fills the card. Low separation.
Pier plus beach and sea fill the whole frame. No single hero and the horizon splits the card. Wide environment shot.
